description: Frontend: add the realtime battle experience to the public app (index.html) and thread the WebSocket endpoint through config + Amplify build. A HOST (authenticated via the existing Cognito Hosted UI, reusing auth.ts) creates a room from an existing registered quiz and gets a shareable room ID; PARTICIPANTS join with a display name + room ID (NO login); the host starts and advances question by question; everyone sees the same synced question and a live scoreboard of participant names + scores. Uses ONLY the native browser WebSocket API. Frontend deps remain EXACTLY react + react-dom. All existing single-player flows (list/chooseMode/quiz/result/history, all + oneByOne) and the admin page remain fully intact. Depends on FEAT-002 for the WebSocketEndpoint and the action/message contract.
steps: In frontend/src/config.ts, add `export const WS_URL = (import.meta.env.VITE_WS_URL ?? '').replace(/\/$/, '')` mirroring the existing API_BASE/COGNITO_* handling (trailing-slash-stripped). Do not change existing exports.

In amplify.yml, add `VITE_WS_URL=${WS_URL}` to the heredoc that generates frontend/.env in the preBuild phase, mirroring the existing API_BASE -> VITE_API_BASE line, and update the surrounding comments to list WS_URL -> VITE_WS_URL. The Amplify console env var name is WS_URL (set to the CDK WebSocketEndpoint CfnOutput).

In frontend/.env.example, add a commented VITE_WS_URL example line (e.g. wss://xxxx.execute-api.ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/prod) mirroring the VITE_API_BASE example and noting it comes from the CDK WebSocketEndpoint output.

Create frontend/src/ws.ts: a thin typed wrapper over the native WebSocket. Provide a small class or factory that opens `new WebSocket(WS_URL)`, exposes send(action, payload) that JSON.stringifies `{action, ...payload}`, and typed inbound message handling. Define TypeScript types for outbound actions (createRoom{quizId, idToken}, joinRoom{roomId, name}, startGame{roomId, idToken}, submitAnswer{roomId, name, answerIndex}, nextQuestion{roomId, idToken}, endGame{roomId, idToken}) and a discriminated-union inbound message type (roomCreated{roomId}, state{phase, question?, scoreboard}, error{message}, etc.) matching the contract implemented in lambda/ws.ts. No new npm deps.

Create frontend/src/pages/BattlePage.tsx: encapsulates the battle experience with an internal view state (choose role -> host lobby / participant join -> live game -> finished). HOST path: reuse auth.ts (restoreToken/captureTokenFromHash on mount, loginUrl to redirect to Hosted UI when not authenticated, logoutUrl); once authenticated, fetch the existing quiz list via api.getQuizzes(), let the host pick a quiz, call ws createRoom (passing the id token), show the returned room ID to share, and show startGame / next / end controls. PARTICIPANT path: a form for display name + room ID, then ws joinRoom (no token). BOTH: render the current question (options selectable; submit posts answerIndex) and the live scoreboard (names + scores, host-advanced timing for v1). Reuse styles.css classes/design tokens; Japanese UI copy. Never rely on any answerIndex from the server for participants.

Wire BattlePage into the public app WITHOUT adding a router: in frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx, extend `type View` with a 'battle' entry and add an entry button (e.g. on the list screen and/or result screen: 'リアルタイム対戦') that sets view='battle' and renders <BattlePage onBack={() => setView('list')} />. Keep every existing view (list/chooseMode/quiz/result/history) and its behavior unchanged, including the single submitAnswers/append history path. Do NOT alter admin-main.tsx / AdminPage.tsx.

In frontend/src/styles.css, add classes for the battle UI (role chooser, host lobby with shareable room ID, participant join form, live question card, live scoreboard/ranking list, connection status). Reuse existing design tokens and the existing .card/.btn/.quiz-actions/.progress conventions; the global dark-mode and prefers-reduced-motion rules already apply.
Confirm frontend/package.json is unchanged (still exactly react + react-dom as dependencies) and that no lockfile is created.
acceptance_criteria: frontend/src/config.ts exports WS_URL derived from import.meta.env.VITE_WS_URL (trailing slash stripped).
amplify.yml maps WS_URL -> VITE_WS_URL in the generated frontend/.env, mirroring API_BASE; frontend/.env.example documents VITE_WS_URL.
frontend/src/ws.ts wraps the native WebSocket with typed outbound actions and a typed inbound message union matching lambda/ws.ts, adding no npm deps.

frontend/src/pages/BattlePage.tsx implements host (Cognito login via auth.ts + create/start/advance/end) and participant (name+roomId join, no login) flows with a live synced question and live scoreboard, using only the native WebSocket.
HomePage.tsx reaches BattlePage via an extended View state machine (no react-router) and ALL existing single-player views/behaviors remain intact; the admin page is untouched.
frontend/package.json dependencies remain EXACTLY react + react-dom and no lockfile is added.
verification: User runs (networked host) `cd frontend && npm install && npm run build` and confirms `tsc -b && vite build` succeed with no type errors and both index.html + admin.html bundles emit.

User runs `cd frontend && npm run dev`, opens the public app, enters the battle feature: as host logs in via Cognito and creates a room; as a participant (separate browser/incognito) joins with name+roomID; host starts and advances; both see synced questions and a live scoreboard.
Read BattlePage.tsx + ws.ts and confirm participants never receive or rely on answerIndex, participants need no login, and the host uses the existing auth.ts Hosted UI helpers.
Read frontend/package.json and confirm dependencies are exactly react + react-dom and git status shows no new lockfile.
findings:
Implemented the realtime battle FRONTEND in the public app (index.html). Verified correct-by-construction only: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox has no frontend/node_modules and npm registry is 403, so `npm install`/`tsc -b`/`vite build`/`npm run dev` could NOT run here. The user must run `cd frontend && npm install && npm run build` (tsc -b && vite build) and `npm run dev` on a networked host.

CONFIG (frontend/src/config.ts): added `export const WS_URL = (import.meta.env.VITE_WS_URL ?? '').replace(/\/$/, '')` mirroring API_BASE/COGNITO_* (trailing-slash-stripped). Existing exports untouched. Also added `readonly VITE_WS_URL?: string` to ImportMetaEnv in frontend/src/vite-env.d.ts so tsc resolves import.meta.env.VITE_WS_URL under strict mode.

AMPLIFY (amplify.yml): added `VITE_WS_URL=${WS_URL}` to the .env heredoc in preBuild (mirrors the VITE_API_BASE line) and updated the header comments to list WS_URL -> VITE_WS_URL and document WS_URL = CDK CfnOutput WebSocketEndpoint. frontend/.env.example: added a `VITE_WS_URL=wss://...prod` example line noting it comes from the WebSocketEndpoint output.

WS WRAPPER (frontend/src/ws.ts, NEW): thin typed wrapper over the native browser WebSocket, NO new deps. Exports class `BattleSocket` with connect() (opens `new WebSocket(WS_URL)`, throws if WS_URL empty), send<A>(action, payload) which JSON.stringifies {action, ...payload} and returns false if not OPEN, close(), isOpen(), wasClosedByClient(), and a private parseMessage that JSON-parses inbound text frames into a typed InboundMessage (returns null for non-string/invalid/typeless). Handlers: onOpen/onMessage/onClose/onError. TYPES match FEAT-002 contract EXACTLY: outbound OutboundActionMap { createRoom:{token,quizId}; joinRoom:{name,roomId}; startGame:{token,roomId}; submitAnswer:{answerIndex}; nextQuestion:{token,roomId}; endGame:{token,roomId} }. Inbound discriminated union InboundMessage on `type`: roomCreated{roomId,quizId,quizTitle,questionCount}; joined{roomId,name,quizTitle,questionCount}; state{roomId,phase,currentQuestion,questionCount,quizTitle,question:ParticipantQuestion|null,scoreboard:ScoreboardEntry[]}; answerAck{n,correct}; error{message}. ParticipantQuestion={n,text,options} has NO answerIndex; ScoreboardEntry={name,score}. BattlePhase='lobby'|'in_question'|'between'|'finished'.

BATTLE PAGE (frontend/src/pages/BattlePage.tsx, NEW): internal view state machine (chooseRole -> host | participant), NO router. Default export BattlePage({onBack}).
 - RoleChooser: two .mode-option cards (ホストになる / 参加する) + back to quiz list.
 - HostBattle: reuses auth.ts EXACTLY as-is (captureTokenFromHash + restoreToken on mount; loginUrl()/logoutUrl() redirect via window.location.assign; clearToken on logout). Because auth.ts adminPageUrl()=origin+pathname is page-agnostic, login on index.html redirects back to index.html (FEAT-002 added those Cognito callback/logout URLs). When unauthenticated shows a login prompt. When authed: opens a BattleSocket, loads api.getQuizzes() into a <select>, createRoom sends {token:idToken, quizId}; on roomCreated shows the shareable room id (monospace, letter-spaced); controls are phase-driven: lobby->ゲーム開始(startGame); in_question->正解を表示(nextQuestion); between->次の設問へ(nextQuestion); any non-finished->終了する(endGame); finished->対戦を終える(onBack). Host renders the live question read-only (interactive=false) + live scoreboard from `state`.
 - ParticipantBattle: NO login. Name(maxLength 40)+roomId form; on submit trims name, trims+UPPERCASES roomId (server also trims/uppercases), opens BattleSocket and sends joinRoom on onOpen. On `joined` switches to the live view; renders the synced question with selectable options (interactive=true) and submits {action:'submitAnswer', answerIndex} (answerIndex only; room/name inferred server-side). Tracks selectedIndex (reset when currentQuestion changes) and answeredForN (from answerAck.n) to disable re-answering the same question and show 正解/不正解. Live scoreboard highlights the participant's own row. Never reads/relies on any answerIndex from the server.
 - Shared subcomponents: ConnectionBadge (connecting/open/closed/error), LiveQuestion (progress + question card + options; interactive flag), Scoreboard (ordered ranking, optional highlightName).

HOMEPAGE WIRING (frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx): extended `type View` with 'battle' (now list|chooseMode|quiz|result|history|battle). Added `import BattlePage from './BattlePage'`. QuizList now takes onStartBattle and renders a 'リアルタイム対戦' button in BOTH the empty-state and populated .quiz-actions (primary variant when quizzes exist). Added `{view === 'battle' && <BattlePage onBack={() => setView('list')} />}`. ALL existing views (list/chooseMode/quiz/result/history), the single submitAnswers+history.append path, and admin-main.tsx/AdminPage.tsx are untouched.

STYLES (frontend/src/styles.css): added a 'リアルタイム対戦' block (.battle, .battle-lead, .battle-me, .battle-conn + status dot variants, .battle-roles/.battle-host/.battle-participant/.battle-join containers, .battle-roomid-card/-value (monospace, letter-spaced), .battle-room-input, .battle-live/.battle-question-text/.battle-options, .battle-phase-note, .battle-scoreboard/.battle-ranking/.battle-ranking-item/.battle-ranking-me/.battle-rank/.battle-rank-name/.battle-rank-score) reusing existing design tokens and the card-in/item-in/pulse keyframes; global dark-mode + prefers-reduced-motion already apply. Reused existing .card/.btn/.btn.primary/.quiz-actions/.progress/.option/.mode-option/.admin-field/.admin-input/.empty-state classes.

DEPS: frontend/package.json UNCHANGED (still exactly react ^18.3.1 + react-dom ^18.3.1 as dependencies; devDeps unchanged). No lockfile created (git status shows no package-lock.json). Only the native browser WebSocket API is used; no react-router, no new packages.

DEVIATIONS: (1) Added VITE_WS_URL to frontend/src/vite-env.d.ts (not explicitly listed in the steps but required for strict tsc to type import.meta.env.VITE_WS_URL, mirroring the existing VITE_* declarations). (2) Host-advanced timing for v1 as specified: no per-question timer; the host presses 正解を表示 then 次の設問へ. (3) The entry button label is 'リアルタイム対戦' on the list screen (both empty and populated states); did not also add it to the result screen (the plan said 'and/or').

VERIFICATION LIMITATION: could not run tsc/vite in-sandbox (no node_modules, registry 403). Authored strict-mode-clean (noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters/noFallthroughCasesInSwitch respected; discriminated-union switches narrow on `type` with break in every case). User must confirm with `cd frontend && npm install && npm run build`.
